name: deepseek_v2_attention_indexer_no_w_scale_qkv_a_weight_bfloat16_w_uk_t_bfloat16_o_proj_weight_bfloat16_n_heads8_nope_dim192_kv_lora_rank512_v_head_dim256_model_dim6144_topk2048_q_lora_rank2048_qkv_a_rows2624_ix_heads32_ix_dim128
description: sglang's DeepseekV2DecoderLayer up to its MLP on one rank, in the layers that run the DSA indexer, from the residual stream hidden_states: x = RMSNorm(hidden_states) input_norm_weight; qkv_a = x qkv_a_weight^T splits into q_a, the kv latent and k_pe; q_lora = RMSNorm(q_a), k_latent = RMSNorm(kv latent), q = q_lora q_b_weight^T. An fp8 weight is dequantized per 128 x 128 block and takes its input as the checkpoint's FP8 scheme quantizes it: in bf16, as the model holds its activations, then each 1 x 128 group in fp8 at a scale of its amax / 448. The indexer's q is each head of q_lora wq_b^T and its k is LayerNorm(x wk^T), both turned by RoPE on their first 2 half_rope values (by index_cos_cache and index_sin_cache), then the Hadamard transform over ix_dim times ix_dim^-0.5 (fast_hadamard_transform's order); the heads' weights are x weights_proj^T * ix_heads^-0.5 * ix_dim^-0.5. Each token's k is stored into index_k_cache at its slot of out_cache_loc (page slot // 64, key slot % 64) in fp8 at a scale of 2^ceil(log2(max(amax, 1e-4) / 448)) of its values. The scores: for each of a token's first seq_lens[m] positions t, sum_h weights[h] relu(<q[h], k(t)>), k(t) the key at slot page_table[m, t // 64] * 64 + t % 64: one of this call's k, else the cache's values times their scale. topk_indices are their topk highest (all of them in position order when there are no more), each position t as its slot, -1 past them: the token's top-k slots. Ties and a full row's order are the kernel's choice. RoPE turns pair (x[2i], x[2i + 1]) by cos_cache and sin_cache at the token's position. A token's KV row is k_latent, then RoPE(k_pe), stored into kv_cache at its slot of out_cache_loc. Each head attends with q = (q_nope w_uk_t^T w_scale, RoPE(q_pe)) over the KV cache rows the token's top-k slots name (-1: none), the rows just stored among them: scores q . row * sm_scale, values the rows' latent part (0 when no row). The heads' outputs times w_uv w_scale, then o_proj (an fp8 one as the linears above). w_scale comes with fp8 w_uk_t and w_uv only; bf16 ones are as they are. output is hidden_states plus o_proj's output summed over the ranks of the kernel's peer memory, in rank order: the stream after the attention.

ix_dim.description: A key and a head: the pages' 128.

q_b_rows.description: q's columns: the rank's heads times a head's q_nope and q_pe.

index_cols.description: wq_b's rows: the indexer heads times a head.

page_bytes.description: A page: 64 keys of ix_dim fp8 values, then their fp32 scales.

hidden_states.description: The residual stream the layer starts from.

qkv_a_weight.description: fused_qkv_a_proj_with_mqa: q_a_proj's rows, then kv_a_proj_with_mqa's (the kv latent, then k_pe).

q_b_weight.description: This rank's rows of q_b_proj: each head's q_nope, then its q_pe.

wq_b.description: wq_b: each head's rows in turn.

index_cos_cache.description: RoPE's cosines by position and pair.

index_sin_cache.description: RoPE's sines by position and pair.

out_cache_loc.description: Each token's slot in the KV cache.

index_k_cache.description: This layer's index-K cache: pages of 64 keys' fp8 values in 16 x 16 tiles (16 keys by 16 values), then their fp32 scales; the tokens' keys are stored into it.

seq_lens.description: Each token's positions, its own included; at most 2^20, the DSA models' longest context.

page_table.description: Each token's pages in position order, distinct within a row.

kv_cache.description: This layer's KV cache: a row per slot, the latent then the RoPE part; the tokens' rows are stored into it.

cos_cache.description: RoPE's cosines by position and pair.

sin_cache.description: RoPE's sines by position and pair.

w_uk_t.description: kv_b_proj's W_UK per head, transposed: (latent, q_nope).

output.description: The residual stream after the attention.

topk_indices.description: The slots each token attends; -1: none.
